docs.title: GA4GH Place-Based Exposure Metadata Schema
docs.text:
A LinkML schema describing how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord describes one exposure variable linked in one cohort.

Status: Draft (version 0.1.0), developed by the GA4GH Human Exposome Data Standards Study Group.

  • Schema documentation
  • Downloads: LinkML YAML · JSON Schema
  • Source repository and examples

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Environmental exposures such as air pollution, diet, physical activity, and social stress can influence the onset of disease. Environmental data is captured in different ways by research groups internationally, making it hard to compare or combine.

The Human Exposome Data Standards Study Group is developing shared, machine-readable ways to describe environmental exposures. This schema covers place-based exposures: how a source exposure product was linked to the locations of cohort participants.

Aims of the group: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21877291

docs.title: GA4GH Environmental Exposure Linkage Metadata
docs.text:
Describes how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord = one exposure variable linked in one cohort. Converted from "Implementation 1 - GA4GH Metadata Schema".

URI: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage

Name: exposure_linkage

name: Citation

    name: doi
    description: 'Bare DOI, without the doi: prefix or resolver URL, e.g. 10.1234/abcd.'

    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage

  accessed:
    name: accessed
    description: Date the URL was accessed. Required when url is given without a DOI.
    title: Accessed
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: Citation
    domain_of:
    - Citation
    range: date
  text:
    name: text
    description: Free-text citation, for sources without a DOI or URL.
    title: Citation text
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: Citation
    domain_of:
    - Citation
    range: string

    name: used_for_linkage
    description: True if this is the source actually used for the linkage. Replaces
      the old "*" marker.
    title: Used for linkage
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: Citation
    domain_of:
    - Citation

- slot_conditions:
    doi:
      name: doi
      required: true
- slot_conditions:

      name: url
      required: true
- slot_conditions:

  Domain", "Exposure Variable Name", "Ontology / Taxonomy Term ID" and "Unit of Measure".

from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
attributes:

    name: domain
    description: Broad exposure domain.
    title: Exposure Domain
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - ExposureVariable
    range: ExposureDomainEnum
    required: true
  domain_other:

    description: Free-text domain. Required when domain = OTHER.
    title: Exposure Domain (other)
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - ExposureVariable
    range: string

    title: Exposure Variable Name
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - Cohort
    - ExposureVariable
    - Person
    range: string
    required: true
  ontology_terms:
    name: ontology_terms
    description: 'Resolvable identifiers for the exposure. Chemicals: INCHIKEY (preferred),
      PUBCHEM, DTXSID, CAS. Physical or environmental exposures: ExO, ENVO, MESH.
      Leave empty if no term exists.'
    title: Ontology / Taxonomy Term ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - ExposureVariable
    range: CURIE
    recommended: true
    multivalued: true
  unit:
    name: unit
    description: UCUM code for the unit of the linked values. Omit for categorical
      variables.
    title: Unit of Measure
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - ExposureVariable
    - ValidationMetric
    - Uncertainty
    range: UcumCode
  is_categorical:
    name: is_categorical
    description: True if the variable takes categorical rather than numeric values.
    title: Is categorical
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage
    rank: 1000
    owner: ExposureVariable
    domain_of:
    - ExposureVariable
    range: boolean
rules:
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      domain:
        name: domain
        equals_string: OTHER
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      domain_other:
        name: domain_other
        required: true
  description: OTHER domain must be specified.

docs.title: Enum: Validation metric (ValidationMetricEnum)
docs.text: Validation statistic.

docs.title: Slot: Accessed (accessed)
docs.text: Date the URL was accessed. Required when url is given without a DOI.

docs.title: Slot: Cohort acronym (acronym)
docs.text: Short name, e.g. UKB. Split out of the old "Name (ACRONYM)" string.

docs.title: Slot: Administrative unit approximate population (admin_unit_approx_population)
docs.text: Typical population of one administrative unit.

docs.title: Slot: Administrative unit name (admin_unit_name)
docs.text: For ADMINISTRATIVE_UNIT, the unit type, e.g. LSOA, census tract.

docs.title: Slot: Summary Statistic / Aggregation (aggregation)
docs.text: Summary statistic applied to the exposure values. Buffer geometry is recorded once, under operation.

docs.title: Slot: Aggregation N (aggregation_n)
docs.text: N for MULTI_YEAR_MEAN (years) or PERCENTILE (the percentile).

docs.title: Slot: Buffer Distance (buffer_radii_m)
docs.text: Buffer radii in metres. Required for CIRCULAR_BUFFER; list all radii if several were reported.

docs.title: Slot: Carried to participant level (carried_to_participant_level)
docs.text: True if uncertainty is propagated to the participant-level exposure values.

docs.title: Slot: Cell height (cell_height)
docs.text: Grid cell height; metres for GRID_METRIC, degrees for GRID_DEGREE.

docs.title: Slot: Cell width (cell_width)
docs.text: Grid cell width; metres for GRID_METRIC, degrees for GRID_DEGREE.

docs.title: Slot: Centroid areal unit (centroid_areal_unit)
docs.text: The areal unit the centroid represents, e.g. "output area".

docs.title: Slot: Centroid weighting (centroid_weighting)
docs.text: _How the centroid was computed. Required for any *CENTROID unit.

docs.title: Slot: Data Source Citation / URL (citations)
docs.text: Citations for the source dataset and the methods used to produce it.

docs.title: Slot: Cohort (cohort)
docs.text: The cohort or study whose participants received the exposure values.

docs.title: Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
docs.text: Countries in which participant data were collected, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

docs.title: Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Country of Participant Data Collection (collection_countries)
Slot: Coverage unit (coverage_unit)
docs.text: Unit that participant_coverage_pct counts.

docs.title: Slot: Creator(s) (creators)
docs.text: People responsible for producing this linkage.

docs.title: Slot: Model / Dataset Name (dataset_name)
docs.text: Name of the model or dataset, e.g. ELAPSE LUR, ERA5, MODIS MOD13A3.

docs.title: Slot: Model / Dataset Version (dataset_version)
docs.text: Version number or release year, e.g. 2.0, 006, 2023.

docs.title: Slot: Relinkage date (date)
docs.text: Date of the re-run.

docs.title: Slot: Coverage description (description)
docs.text: Optional note, e.g. "UK-wide", "multiple provinces".

docs.title: Slot: DOI (doi)
docs.text: Bare DOI, without the doi: prefix or resolver URL, e.g. 10.1234/abcd.

docs.title: Slot: Exposure Domain (domain)
docs.text: Broad exposure domain.

docs.title: Slot: Exposure Domain (other) (domain_other)
docs.text: Free-text domain. Required when domain = OTHER.

docs.title: Slot: Email (email)
docs.text: Contact email address.

docs.title: Slot: Date Coverage - End (end)
docs.text: Last date covered, as an ISO 8601 partial date. Omit when ongoing = true.

docs.title: Slot: Exposure (exposure)
docs.text: The exposure variable that was linked.

docs.title: exposure_linkage
docs.text:
Describes how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord = one exposure variable linked in one cohort. Converted from "Implementation 1 - GA4GH Metadata Schema".

URI: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage

docs.title: Slot: Exposure Window (exposure_window)
docs.text: Period of exposure the linked values represent.

docs.title: Slot: Exposure window detail (exposure_window_detail)
docs.text: Further detail, e.g. trimester or age range.

docs.title: Slot: Exposure window (years) (exposure_window_years)
docs.text: Length of the exposure window in years, e.g. N for N_YEARS_BEFORE_INDEX.

docs.title: Slot: Geocoding Database Version (geocoder)
docs.text: Geocoding database name and version or release date.

docs.title: Slot: Geocoding mixed breakdown (geocoding_mixed_breakdown)
docs.text: For MIXED precision, the share of each level, e.g. "80% building, 20% postcode".

docs.title: Slot: Geocoding Precision (geocoding_precision)
docs.text: Precision of participant geocodes.

docs.title: Slot: Geographic Coverage (geographic_coverage)
docs.text: Area covered by the source dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Record identifier (id)
docs.text: Stable record identifier, e.g. UKB-NO2-ELAPSE-2010.

docs.title: Slot: Intersection minimum overlap (%) (intersection_min_overlap_pct)
docs.text: Minimum areal overlap, in percent, for INTERSECTION.

docs.title: Slot: Is categorical (is_categorical)
docs.text: True if the variable takes categorical rather than numeric values.

docs.title: Slot: Kernel bandwidth (m) (kernel_bandwidth_m)
docs.text: Kernel bandwidth in metres. Required for KERNEL_DENSITY_WEIGHTED.

docs.title: Slot: Kernel grid resolution (m) (kernel_grid_resolution_m)
docs.text: Output grid resolution of the kernel density surface, in metres.

docs.title: Slot: Last updated (last_updated)
docs.text: Date of the most recent update. Required when ongoing = true.

docs.title: Slot: Linkage (linkage)
docs.text: How exposure values were assigned to participants.

docs.title: Slot: Linkage Date (linkage_date)
docs.text: Date the linkage was performed.

docs.title: Slot: Lower bound (lower)
docs.text: Lower bound of the uncertainty interval.

docs.title: Slot: Metric (metric)
docs.text: The validation statistic.

docs.title: Slot: Network distance (m) (network_distance_m)
docs.text: Network buffer distance in metres.

docs.title: Slot: Network mode (network_mode)
docs.text: Travel mode for NETWORK_BUFFER.

docs.title: Slot: Network time (min) (network_time_min)
docs.text: Network buffer travel time in minutes.

docs.title: Slot: Ongoing (ongoing)
docs.text: True if the dataset is still being extended. Replaces the magic string "Ongoing".

docs.title: Slot: Ontology / Taxonomy Term ID (ontology_terms)
docs.text: Resolvable identifiers for the exposure. Chemicals: INCHIKEY (preferred), PUBCHEM, DTXSID, CAS. Physical or environmental exposures: ExO, ENVO, MESH. Leave empty if no term exists.

docs.title: Slot: Spatial Linkage Operation (operation)
docs.text: GIS operation used to assign values.

docs.title: Slot: ORCID (orcid)
docs.text: ORCID identifier as a CURIE, e.g. ORCID:0000-0002-1825-0097.

docs.title: Slot: Origin of the Data (origin)
docs.text: How the source exposure data were produced.

docs.title: Slot: Missing Data / Coverage (participant_coverage_pct)
docs.text: Percentage (0-100) of coverage units that received an exposure value.

docs.title: Slot: Population dataset (population_dataset)
docs.text: Population dataset used for POPULATION_WEIGHTED centroids.

docs.title: Slot: Reason (reason)
docs.text: Why the linkage was re-run, e.g. geocoder update.

docs.title: Slot: Records (records)
docs.text: The exposure linkage records in this file.

docs.title: Slot: Regions (regions)
docs.text: ISO 3166-1 / ISO 3166-2 codes. Required when scope = COUNTRIES_OR_REGIONS.

docs.title: Slot: Relinkages (relinkages)
docs.text: Later re-runs of the linkage, e.g. after a geocoder update.

docs.title: Slot: Residential History (residential_history)
docs.text: Extent to which residential moves were accounted for.

docs.title: Slot: Residential history detail (residential_history_detail)
docs.text: Free-text detail on how residential history was handled.

docs.title: Slot: Role (role)
docs.text: Role in producing the linkage, e.g. senior investigator.

docs.title: Slot: Scope (scope)
docs.text: Kind of coverage.

docs.title: Slot: Source data (source_data)
docs.text: The upstream exposure product the values were taken from.

docs.title: Slot: Spatial Linkage Unit (spatial_linkage_unit)
docs.text: Participant location used for the linkage.

docs.title: Slot: Spatial Resolution (spatial_resolution)
docs.text: Spatial resolution of the source dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Date Coverage - Start (start)
docs.text: First date covered, as an ISO 8601 partial date.

docs.title: Slot: Study area coverage (%) (study_area_coverage_pct)
docs.text: Percentage (0-100) of the study area covered by the source dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Date Coverage (temporal_coverage)
docs.text: Period covered by the source dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Temporal Resolution (temporal_resolution)
docs.text: Temporal resolution of the source dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Citation text (text)
docs.text: Free-text citation, for sources without a DOI or URL.

docs.title: Slot: Uncertainty (uncertainty)
docs.text: Uncertainty information available for the dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Update frequency (update_frequency)
docs.text: For PERIODIC_UPDATE, the update interval as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P5Y.

docs.title: Slot: Upper bound (upper)
docs.text: Upper bound of the uncertainty interval.

docs.title: Slot: URL (url)
docs.text: Web address of the source or its documentation.

docs.title: Slot: Used for linkage (used_for_linkage)
docs.text: True if this is the source actually used for the linkage. Replaces the old "*" marker.

docs.title: Slot: Validation design (validation_design)
docs.text: How the validation was carried out.

docs.title: Slot: Validation Status (validation_metrics)
docs.text: Reported validation metrics. An empty list with validation_reported = false means the dataset was not validated.

docs.title: Slot: Validation reported (validation_reported)
docs.text: True if the dataset producers report a validation of the dataset.
